item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile, shutil, tempfile, os
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
pptx = Path('/home/user/Desktop/24_8.pptx')
backup = pptx.with_suffix('.pptx.bak_font_change')
if not backup.exists():
    shutil.copy2(pptx, backup)
ns = {'a': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main'}
ET.register_namespace('a', ns['a'])
ET.register_namespace('p', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main')
ET.register_namespace('r', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships')
ET.register_namespace('p14', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2010/main')
ET.register_namespace('p15', 'http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/powerpoint/2012/main')
ET.register_namespace('mc', 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006')
with zipfile.ZipFile(pptx, 'r') as zin:
    entries = {info.filename: (info, zin.read(info.filename)) for info in zin.infolist()}
slide_name = 'ppt/slides/slide5.xml'
root = ET.fromstring(entries[slide_name][1])
changed = 0
for tag in ('latin', 'ea', 'cs'):
    for el in root.findall(f'.//a:{tag}', ns):
        if el.get('typeface') "'!= '"'Times New Roman':
            el.set('typeface', 'Times New Roman')
            changed += 1
# Ensure each text run/end paragraph property has an explicit latin font.
for pr_tag in ('rPr', 'endParaRPr', 'defRPr'):
    for pr in root.findall(f'.//a:{pr_tag}', ns):
        latin = pr.find('a:latin', ns)
        if latin is None:
            latin = ET.SubElement(pr, f\"{{{ns['a']}}}latin\")
            changed += 1
        if latin.get('typeface') "'!= '"'Times New Roman':
            latin.set('typeface', 'Times New Roman')
            changed += 1
new_xml = ET.tostring(root, encoding='UTF-8', xml_declaration=True)
fd, tmpname = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix='.pptx', dir=str(pptx.parent))
os.close(fd)
try:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmpname, 'w') as zout:
        for filename, (info, data) in entries.items():
            zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(filename, date_time=info.date_time)
            zi.compress_type = info.compress_type
            zi.comment = info.comment
            zi.extra = info.extra
            zi.internal_attr = info.internal_attr
            zi.external_attr = info.external_attr
            zout.writestr(zi, new_xml if filename == slide_name else data)
    os.replace(tmpname, pptx)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmpname):
        os.unlink(tmpname)
print(f'Updated {changed} font declarations in {slide_name}')
print(f'Backup: {backup}')
PY"
